environment_observation.fallback: coordinatewise clip of the frozen actor center to the current caps

event: first native goal before any positive native cost, environment stop, or 500-step horizon
attack_rule: pre-block shift opposite the clipped actor center, norm 0.02/sqrt(500) at each executed step
predeclared_checks: All source, dependency, controller, and normalizer hashes match.
The observation flattening order matches the pinned simulator.
The held-out seed list is disjoint from opened development labels.
Every attacked trajectory obeys the pathwise energy bound.
All four arms contain exactly 256 distinct environment seeds.
The confidence allocation is 0.0005 per nominal method.
No source, event, threshold, or endpoint is selected using confirmation results.
claim_limits: The certificate concerns residual action-center shifts, not observation attacks.
The observation-only action constraint is a heuristic and does not assert native safety by itself.
The target 0.5 certificate is reported only if its simultaneous nominal lower bound exceeds 0.5.
The attacked arm is a diagnostic and cannot establish worst-case optimality or theorem validity by sampling.
